Slot4 W3-U10 forge shield bearer: robust armored figure holding a plain tall angular dark-metal directional shield with bronze rim, no human heraldry, shield and whole body fit cell. Slot5 W3-U11 combistick hunter: medium hunting mesh armor, one double-ended metal combistick held vertically/slightly diagonally close to body, use second reference image for same telescoping staff with pointed ends. edits.reason: Background alpha was not sufficiently transparent.

edits.prompt: TRANSPARENCY REPAIR ONLY. Edit the attached SIX-CHARACTER GAME SPRITE ATLAS. The characters, poses, anatomy, clothing, bronze/metal detail, exact weapons, camera, row/column placements and1536x1024dimensions must remain unchanged. It contains a light grey/white background and grey shadows between figures. REMOVE that entire light grey/white backdrop, all background haze and floor/contact shadows completely: every pixel outside the six character-and-equipment silhouettes must have true native alpha0. Keep every solid body, dreadlock, spear, shield, disc, wristblade and rope fully opaque(alpha255 or near255), with only fine antialias at the outer edges. Do not make dark armor translucent to remove the backdrop. EXACTLY six individual figures, same3columns by2rows; do not add/delete/merge/resize/repose/redraw equipment or change their identities. Preserve whole heads, weapons and feet and existing transparent gutters. No new background, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no labels, text, borders, glows, smoke, floor, shadows or extra figures. Final output must be a transparent-background PNG sprite atlas, not an illustration on grey or white.
edits.reason: U11 upper combistick tip had only1px visible gutter at cell top.

Move/angle this held staff just enough inside that SAME cell so the entire top and bottom spear points have at least16pixels clear transparent margin from the cell edges; lower the grip/upper arm slightly and lean the staff a little if needed. rejectedCandidates.reason: Background alpha was not sufficiently transparent.

rejectedCandidates.prompt: TRANSPARENCY REPAIR ONLY. Edit the attached SIX-CHARACTER GAME SPRITE ATLAS. The characters, poses, anatomy, clothing, bronze/metal detail, exact weapons, camera, row/column placements and1536x1024dimensions must remain unchanged. It contains a light grey/white background and grey shadows between figures. REMOVE that entire light grey/white backdrop, all background haze and floor/contact shadows completely: every pixel outside the six character-and-equipment silhouettes must have true native alpha0. Keep every solid body, dreadlock, spear, shield, disc, wristblade and rope fully opaque(alpha255 or near255), with only fine antialias at the outer edges. Do not make dark armor translucent to remove the backdrop. EXACTLY six individual figures, same3columns by2rows; do not add/delete/merge/resize/repose/redraw equipment or change their identities. Preserve whole heads, weapons and feet and existing transparent gutters. No new background, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no labels, text, borders, glows, smoke, floor, shadows or extra figures. Final output must be a transparent-background PNG sprite atlas, not an illustration on grey or white.
rejectedCandidates.reason: U11 upper combistick tip had only1px visible gutter at cell top.

limitations: These sprites are original project role studies, not certified1:1 official film or PHG replicas.
No motion cycle, left-facing authored counterpart or actual battle behavior is claimed.
The speargun uses the existing project feral-speargun reference; official weapon/UV certification remains separate.
Native alpha has low-amplitude edge noise; noiseFloor2 is metadata/private readback only, source bytes remain unchanged.
Human art approval, exact world contact pivots and collision/render integration remain to be reviewed.
